text: Congested means so crowded or blocked up that it can barely move. Here, big cities are packed with traffic.
Dispersed means spread out over a wide area. Here, many jobs are scattered around the edges of a city.
The periphery is the outer edge of something. Here, it means the outskirts of a city, far from the center.
Rampant means spreading fast and out of control. The writer jokes that motorcycles are like a rampant animal species taking over.
A species is one kind of living thing, like lions or daisies. Here, the writer pretends motorcycles are a species living in the city.
An urban jungle is a big, crowded city that feels wild like a jungle. Here, the writer keeps the animal joke going.
Nimble means quick and light, able to move and turn easily. Motorcycles are nimble because they are small.
Accommodating means welcoming and easy to fit into. Here, the busy streets are a good home for motorcycles.
A habitat is the place where an animal naturally lives. Here, the streets are the motorcycles' habitat in the joke.
To swarm is to move in a big, buzzing crowd, like bees. Here, motorcycles zip around cars in large groups.
A steed is a horse, and trusty means you can count on it. Here, delivery riders depend on their motorcycles like knights on horses.
A courier carries packages or food to people. Here, many riders deliver meals on their motorcycles.
Registered means officially listed with the government. A registered motorcycle has its owner and number on record.
A fleet is a whole group of vehicles. Here, it means all the motorcycles in Mexico.
Quadrupled means became four times as big. Mexico went from 2.6 million motorcycles to 10.5 million.
To weave is to wind in and out between things. Riders weave through slow traffic.
Public transport means buses, trains, and subways that anyone can ride. Here, it has not kept up as cities grew.
Informal means not planned or officially organized. Here, the cities grew in messy ways without a plan.
Sprawl is a city spreading out in all directions without much planning. Here, it makes trips long.
Disproportionately means far more than a fair share. Here, motorcycle buyers are mostly young, poor, and male.
Gig workers do short jobs paid one at a time, often through phone apps. Here, many ride motorcycles for deliveries.
Subsidised means helped with money from the government so the price is lower. Here, the loans cost delivery workers less.
Exempt means excused from a rule or payment. Here, small motorbikes do not have to pay a vehicle tax.
A toll is a fee you pay to use a road or bridge. Here, motorcycles in Colombia pay none.
Domestic means inside your own country. Here, domestic industries are the local factories that make bikes.
A labour market is the place, in a way, where workers and employers find each other. When it works well, people can find jobs easily.
A commute is the trip between home and work or school. Shorter, cheaper commutes help people take more jobs.
Unskilled jobs do not need special training. Here, many of them are far from where poor families live.
A capital is the city where a country's government sits. Montevideo is the capital of Uruguay.
Montevideo is the capital city of Uruguay, a country in South America.
Uruguay is a small country in South America, between Brazil and Argentina.
Bogotá is the capital city of Colombia.
São Paulo is the biggest city in Brazil.
Mexico City is the capital of Mexico and one of the largest cities in the world.
Risk management means finding ways to lower the chance of harm. The heading hints that the next part is about danger.
Carnage means terrible loss of life. Here, it describes the huge number of road deaths.
Inevitable means certain to happen and impossible to avoid. The expert says these deaths are not inevitable.
Fatalities are deaths, here from accidents.
Divergence means going in different directions. Here, deaths fell in other regions but rose in Latin America.
A regulation is a rule made by the government. Here, helmet and speed rules are often weak or ignored.
A licence is official permission to do something, like drive. Many riders ignore the rules about them.

forms: with one eye on their phones
text: With one eye on something means only half paying attention. Here, riders look at their phones while riding.
Here, appetite means desire or willingness. Politicians do not really want to pass tougher rules.
A constituency is a group of voters a politician wants support from. Here, riders are such a group.
To court a group is to try to win its favor. Here, politicians try to win riders' votes.
Moteros is Spanish for motorcycle riders.
A blockade is something that blocks a road so nothing can pass. Here, protesters blocked roads.
